feedback: Your essay addresses an important debate and attempts to balance the benefits of technology with the need to protect privacy and focus in the classroom. You have included a clear introduction and conclusion, and you make valid points regarding equity for learners who may not own devices or have data. However, be careful when constructing your sentences; in your third paragraph, you accidentally state that 'personal messages appearing on a shared screen should not be placed at a disadvantage,' which creates a confusing and ungrammatical idea. Make sure your examples directly support your claims without repeating phrases awkwardly. Proofread your work carefully to ensure every sentence makes logical sense and clearly communicates your intended argument to the reader.
